name: io.github.Lobstack-ai/lobstack-mcp
title: Lobstack API
description: The Lobstack API as an MCP server: one key across many model providers, and what each call cost.

runtimeArguments.description: Skip the install prompt. The server is invoked as npx -y @lobstack-ai/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: LOBSTACK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Lobstack API key from Console → API keys. Optional: lobstack_route_preview works with no key. The other tools need it. Read once at startup, never logged, never a tool argument.

environmentVariables.name: LOBSTACK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Lobstack API base URL. Defaults to https://www.lobstack.ai/api/gateway/v1. Change it only for a staging deployment. Use www; the bare apex redirects and strips Authorization.
